newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Nov 11.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- Veterans of the International Brigade met in Spain for the 60th anniversary of the country's civil war.
- Cuban leader Fidel Castro's presence at a Latin American conference in Chile has roused protests.
- A bomb exploded in a Moscow cemetery, killing at least 13 people who were attending a memorial service.
- The U.S. Senate's Republican Party leader disagreed with President Bill Clinton over campaign financing and Medicare.
- President Clinton is preparing health care legislation for Congress.
